def factor_intraday_downside_pressure(df):
    """Volume-confirmed intraday downside excursion from prior close to low, accumulated and negated."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prior_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    downside_excursion = np.maximum((prior_close - df_copy["low"]) / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan), 0.0)
    vol_mean = df_copy["volume"].rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)
    downside_shock = downside_excursion * vol_ratio
    pressure = downside_shock.rolling(20, min_periods=5).sum()
    df_copy["factor_intraday_downside_pressure"] = -pressure
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_downside_pressure"]
description: Mutation preserves the parent's core mechanism of volume-confirmed downside selling pressure and its negative sign orientation (higher factor = lower selling pressure). It replaces close-to-close negative returns with the intraday downside excursion from prior close to low, normalized by prior close. This captures informed liquidation and tail risk that occurs during the trading session even when prices recover by close, directly targeting the parent's close-to-close blind spot. Volume confirmation is retained as the single lightweight modifier, and the rolling 20-day accumulation preserves stress build-up. No cross-sectional transform is used to keep the raw economic magnitude consistent with the parent.
